title: Citation Existence Verdict
description: DISCOVER deterministic gate-helper artifact (absorption wave 1; ARS three-state pattern). Output of tools/citation_existence.build_existence_verdict: every external reference is looked up live and lands in exactly one of verified / not_found / lookup_error / skipped. BLOCK iff any ref is CONFIRMED not_found (fabricated-citation signal); lookup_error is a warning, never a block (offline-safe) and never silently verified. Complements (never replaces) the structural citation_integrity_verdict gate: that gate checks anchoring/contradiction against the claim_evidence_map; this one checks the refs exist in the world.

checked.description: One entry per input ref, in input order. Deterministic given the same transport answers.

detail.description: Human-readable lookup evidence (source that answered, match ratio, or the error). Never inlined paper content.

violations.description: One line per confirmed-missing ref. Non-empty iff verdict is BLOCK.

warnings.description: One line per lookup_error ref (could not check; absence unconfirmed).
